avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effects increase bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on bleeding signs

avoid_supplements.name: Garlic supplements (high-dose)
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue or use low-dose only; monitor for bleeding

avoid_supplements.name: Ginkgo biloba
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet activity increases GI and systemic bleeding risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel on bleeding precautions

avoid_supplements.name: Corticosteroids (concurrent use)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Markedly increases GI ulceration and perforation risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; if necessary, use PPI prophylaxis and monitor closely

caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction may decrease meloxicam levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; may require dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild antiplatelet properties; may have additive GI effects
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; counsel on GI symptom monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 fatty acids (high-dose)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Modest antiplatelet effects may add to NSAID bleeding risk
caution_supplements.action: Monitor; maintain standard doses and watch for bleeding signs

avoid_foods.name: Alcohol (>2 drinks/day)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Increases GI irritation, ulceration, and bleeding risk; impairs renal function
avoid_foods.action: Strongly advise minimization; counsel on GI and cardiovascular risks

caution_foods.name: High sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: NSAIDs reduce sodium excretion; excessive intake may worsen fluid retention and hypertension
caution_foods.action: Recommend moderate sodium intake; monitor BP and fluid status

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase meloxicam exposure slightly
caution_foods.action: Limit consumption; monitor for adverse effects if used

monitoring_notes: Monitor for GI symptoms (pain, nausea, dark stools), renal function (BUN, creatinine), blood pressure, and cardiovascular events. Educate patients on increased ulceration/perforation risk, especially with age >65 or prior GI disease; consider PPI prophylaxis for high-risk patients.
